BiblicalUsage: These is the word Daniel uses to point at the kingdoms in his visions. In Daniel 2:40 the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron, and in Daniel 6:6 the presidents and princes assemble together to the king, and in Daniel 7:17 the angel explains, these great beasts, which are four, are four kings which shall arise out of the earth.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the pointing word keeps the visions honest: these kingdoms rise, and these kingdoms fall, and the kingdom of God stands after them.
RelatedEvents: Daniel in the Lions' Den; Nebuchadnezzar's Dream of the Image
